fields.ingredients:
500g Basmati rice
500g Chicken
2 onions, sliced
1 cup yogurt
2 tbsp Biryani masala
fields.description: An aromatic and flavorful layered chicken and rice dish, a staple of Indian celebratory meals.
fields.steps:
Parboil rice with whole spices until 70% cooked.
Marinate chicken in yogurt and masala for 30 minutes.
Layer chicken and rice in a heavy-bottom pot
Cook on low heat (Dum) for 20 minutes until aromatic.

fields.ingredients:
250g Paneer cubes
1 cup Tomato puree
1/2 cup Heavy cream
1 Onion, finely chopped
fields.description: Grilled paneer cubes in a rich, creamy, and spicy tomato-based gravy.
fields.steps:
Grill marinated paneer cubes until slightly charred.
Sauté onions and ginger-garlic paste until brown.
Add tomato puree and spices; simmer until oil separates.
Stir in cream and add grilled paneer.

fields.ingredients:
2 Salmon fillets
2 tbsp Butter
3 cloves Garlic, minced
1 Lemon
fields.description: Quick and healthy pan-seared salmon with a zesty garlic butter glaze.
fields.steps:
Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Sear in butter and garlic for 4 minutes per side.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top.
Serve with steamed asparagus.

fields.ingredients:
1 can Coconut milk
2 tbsp Green curry paste
Assorted Broccoli and Carrots
Tofu cubes
fields.description: A spicy, creamy, and fragrant Thai curry packed with fresh vegetables.
fields.steps:
Fry curry paste in a little oil until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and bring to a gentle boil.
Add vegetables and tofu; simmer until tender.
Garnish with fresh Thai basil.

fields.ingredients:
200g Prawns, cleaned
1 cup Panko breadcrumbs
1 Egg, beaten
Paprika and Salt
fields.description: Crunchy on the outside and juicy on the inside, served with spicy mayo.
fields.steps:
Coat prawns in flour, then dip in beaten egg.
Roll in breadcrumbs until fully covered.
Deep fry until golden brown and crispy.

fields.description: A popular Indo-Chinese appetizer featuring drummettes fried in a spicy red batter.
Warm, buttery, and cheesy bread that makes the perfect meal companion.
fields.steps: Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until bubbly.

fields.description: Light and crispy appetizers filled with savory stir-fried vegetables.
fields.steps: Deep fry until crispy and light brown.

fields.description: Decadent chocolate cake with a warm, gooey liquid center.
A smooth, no-bake tropical cheesecake perfect for summer.
fields.steps: Chill in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours.

fields.ingredients:
1 cup Milk powder
1/4 cup Flour
1 tbsp Ghee
2 cups Sugar syrup
fields.description: Iconic Indian sweet made of fried dough balls soaked in rose-flavored syrup.
fields.steps:
Make soft dough balls from milk powder and flour.
Fry balls on low heat until dark golden brown.
Soak immediately in hot cardamom-scented sugar syrup.

fields.ingredients:
2 cups Water
1 cup Milk
2 tsp Tea leaves
Ginger and Cardamom
fields.description: A warming and spiced Indian milk tea that awakens the senses.
fields.steps:
Boil water with crushed ginger and cardamom.
Add tea leaves and sugar; simmer for 2 minutes.
Add milk and bring to a second boil.
Strain into cups and serve hot.

fields.ingredients:
1 cup Milk
1 Espresso shot
1 tbsp Caramel syrup
Ice cubes
fields.description: A refreshing and layered cold coffee drink with sweet caramel notes.
fields.steps:
Drizzle caramel syrup into a cold glass.
Fill with ice and pour in the milk.
Gently pour the espresso shot over the top.

fields.ingredients:
10 fresh Mint leaves
1/2 Lime, sliced
1 tbsp Sugar
Soda water
fields.description: A zesty and cooling lime and mint drink (non-alcoholic).
fields.steps:
Muddle mint leaves, lime, and sugar in a glass.
Fill the glass with crushed ice.
Top with chilled soda water and stir gently.

fields.ingredients:
Romaine Lettuce
Croutons
Parmesan cheese shavings
Caesar dressing
fields.description: The world's most famous salad with a creamy, tangy garlic-parmesan dressing.
fields.steps:
Wash and chop the lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
Toss lettuce with the creamy dressing.
Add croutons and top with parmesan shavings.
